summary: Frontend-only validation of the new Admin 'AI Based Auto Promotions' module (/admin/auto-promotions). All requested scenarios passed end-to-end: render & empty state, conditional fields (trip_count→threshold, inactive_user→inactive-days, percentage→max with proper teardown on switch back to flat), create, edit (prefill + update), toggle (Actif↔Inactif), and delete (window.confirm accepted, 'Supprimée' toast, returns to empty state). DB left clean with zero auto promotions.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminAutoPromotions.js has a duplicated initial load: the useCallback `load` and the useEffect both call adminAPI.listAutoPromotions() independently. Not a bug but redundant — the useEffect could simply call `load()` (would still need an `alive` guard or be the body of useEffect using load via dep array).

remove() uses window.confirm — works but native dialog is less testable/uniform with the rest of the app (most modules use a styled confirm). Consider replacing with a UI confirm later for consistency.
On toggle/edit/delete, the code awaits load() but doesn't show optimistic feedback; UX is acceptable but a small toast on toggle success would be a nice addition.
discount_amount is parsed with parseFloat without min validation in the UI (only >0 check on save). Backend should be the source of truth — confirmed not in scope for this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 auto_promotion ('QA Auto Promo' → 'QA Auto Promo v2'), then DELETED at end. Verified empty state restored — DB has zero auto_promotions, live bookings unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-promotions admin CRUD UI is fully functional and wired to /api/auto-promotions/admin. Backend was pre-validated via curl by main agent (rider /best returns promo, ride creation reduces estimated_fare and increments usage_count). Next testing agents working on rider-side fare display should expect auto_promo_id/auto_promo_title/auto_promo_discount fields on ride documents when an active eligible promo exists. UI selects use raw enum values (criteria: first_ride|trip_count|inactive_user|every_trip; discount_type: flat|percentage; status: active|inactive).
